title: Desk Guide: Installments of Payment Arrangements on the Monthly Bill
content:
**Member services desk guide — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): installments on the bill**

*The arranged balance.* The arranged balance of an agreement is the past-due amount moved off the regular bill into the agreement and not yet billed back as installments. It rises by the balance transfer at acceptance and falls as installments are billed, and by the unbilled remainder billed back at payoff, default or termination.

*Billing of installments.* Installments are billed only while the agreement is in active status, one per billing period from the first installment period until the installment count is reached, the last installment being whatever remains of the arranged balance. Each installment is computed under the tier's installment rounding rule.

*Late charges.* A billed installment is part of that bill's charges. Because every tier subjects a missed installment to the ordinary late charge, an installment unpaid past the due date bears the ordinary late charge; because no tier accrues late charges on the arranged balance, the unbilled balance never does.

*Disconnection hold.* Where the tier holds disconnection while the agreement is active, the arranged amount is never the ground for a disconnection while the agreement is active and no installment is missed.

*Retired clause.* The following clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis for the installment billed on a bill:

> ~~A payment above the bill due is applied under the tier's extra payment application.~~ — no longer in force.

**Points of judgement**

| Situation on the arrangement record | Installment billed on the next bill |
|---|---|
| agreement in active status, installment count not yet reached | yes, the next installment |
| agreement in active status, the bill carries the last installment of the count | yes, whatever remains of the arranged balance |
| agreement in offered, completed, defaulted, expired or terminated status | no |

| Amount on the account | Bears the ordinary late charge when unpaid past due |
|---|---|
| an installment already billed | yes |
| the arranged balance not yet billed | no |

superseded_clauses: A payment above the bill due is applied under extra_payment_application.
